SCRAP ARENA

Ram the other cars. Where you hit decides what falls off — hood, bumper, trunk, doors. Lose all 5 parts and you're wrecked. Chain hits for combos, pin cars against walls for double damage, and grab repair, armor and nitro pickups. Watch out for new enemy types as the waves go on. Arrows at the screen edge point to cars you can't see. Collect scrap from wrecks to buy upgrades, and watch for oil, barrels and the boss every 5th wave.

↑Gas ↓Brake / reverse ←→Steer SpaceHandbrake drift ShiftNitro boost (fills from hits and drifts)

Taps and slow bumps don't count — hit hard. Clearing a wave repairs 2 of your parts. You pick a car at the start and after every 2 waves, and the arena changes too. New cars unlock as you go and stay unlocked. Progress and scores are saved in this browser.

📲 Install Scrap Arena

Once installed it opens fullscreen from your home screen, with no browser bars, and single-player works offline.

HOW TO PLAY

Where you hit decides what falls off: hood, bumper, trunk, doors. Lose all 5 parts and you're wrecked. Hit hard; taps don't count.

  • Joystick (left thumb): point where you want to go. Pull back to brake and reverse.
  • DRIFT: hold to slide around corners. Drifting fills nitro.
  • NOS: hold for a burst of speed.
  • J-turn: while reversing, flick the stick a quarter turn to one side and straight back. The car whips round 180° that way. Keyboard: hold ↓ and double-tap ← or →.
  • Shake your phone to show how you feel.

💣 Bomb Run (3v3, alone with bots or online): a bomb drops in an amber ring in the first 10 s. It's played on its own big map, The Depot, with two sites per team (A and B). Carry the bomb into one of theirs and stay still for 5 s to blow it up (+1 point, everyone respawns). Press F (or PASS) to lob it to a team-mate over the low barriers. Wreck the carrier to make them drop it.

🔧 Garage & mods: achievements pay out Garage Points (GP). Spend them in the Garage on car mods like the Flipper, Spike Drop or Harpoon. Fit one at a time; active mods go on the MOD button (key C) with a cooldown, passive ones are always on. Mods are off in the Daily.

🏁 Motor clubs: tap the badge at the top of the menu to join one. Its badge goes on your car, every game earns club points, and clubs race in a new event each week.

Unlocked cars are stronger and each has a perk: 🌀 Drifter, 🐂 Hauler, 🔥 Rocket, 🛡 Fortress, 👻 Phantom.

Chain hits for combos, pin cars against walls for double damage, grab 🔧 repair, 🛡 armor and ⚡ nitro pickups. Arrows at the screen edge point to cars you can't see. Clearing a wave repairs 2 parts. A boss shows up every 5th wave.

💣 BOMB RUN 3v3 · THE DEPOT · YOU + 2 BOTS vs 3 BOTS · 3:00

YOUR CAR

BOTS

HOW IT WORKS

  1. A bomb drops in the first 10 s, marked by an amber ring.
  2. Drive over it to pick it up, then take it to one of the other team's two sites (A or B) on The Depot.
  3. Stop inside their ring and stay still for 5 s. Getting shoved drains the timer; leaving the ring resets it. Base destroyed: +1 point, everyone respawns.
  4. Pass it with F or the PASS button: it's lobbed to a team-mate in front of you (or straight ahead) and flies over the low barriers. Anyone can catch it, so watch for interceptions.
  5. Wreck the carrier and the bomb drops. Your team-mates can't hurt you.
  6. Most points after 3:00 wins.
